paragraphs.notes: This page is part of the INTERNATIONAL SEARCH REPORT appended at the end of the publication. It is the search examiner's citation list, not part of the disclosure: nothing on it is text of the invention, and no chemistry stated here is asserted by the applicant. Box A of the international search report form. The page is an EPO form printed in ENGLISH, not German, so zh and en are the same string. The box heading and the trailing sentence are pre-printed form text; the IPC line is the typed entry. Multiple spaces between the classification symbols are as printed.

illegible: In the application-number box at the top right, the middle of the pre-printed caption 'International Application No' has dropped out in the scan: it reads 'Inter' then a gap of about 8 mm containing only a faint apostrophe-like stroke, then 'onal Application No'. The missing letters are recorded as a gap rather than filled in, though the caption is the form's fixed wording.

Directly below that caption, the third character of the application number is broken: it prints as '1' with no visible crossbar, giving 'PC1/EP 99/06627'. Read as PCT/EP 99/06627 from the form context and from the same number appearing intact elsewhere in the document; flagged here because the glyph itself is not legible as a T.
